description: One Financial KPI Definition this budget holds a target for — a debt service coverage covenant, a cost-per-bin ceiling. The last two columns are computed by refresh_budget from the KPI's own cached figure.

fields.label: KPI Definition
fields.description: Which defined KPI this target is for. One row per KPI — get_budget_variance_report reports a duplicate rather than silently overwriting one target with another.

fields.label: Target Value
fields.description: The value this budget wants the KPI to hold, in the KPI's own unit.

fields.label: Actual Value
fields.description: The KPI's own cached value, as of the last refresh_budget call. Read from compute_kpi's cache rather than recomputed here, so a budget and the KPI dashboard never disagree about the number.

fields.label: Variance %
fields.description: actual_value minus target_value, as a percentage of target_value. Zero when the KPI has no cached value yet or target_value is zero — read actual_value for the honest figure.

fields.label: Threshold %
fields.description: How far variance_pct may move before this target counts as a breach. Warning at 1-2x this number, Critical past 2x.

name: Budget KPI Target
